text: I think the main reason is the quality of education. Some countries have very good universities, so students want to study there. Also, they can learn a foreign language and meet people from different cultures. It can be a great experience, but it is expensive and some students feel lonely. Personally, I would like to try it for one year.

text: In my opinion, it should be free, at least for good students. Education helps the country, because educated people get better jobs and pay more taxes. However, if it is totally free, some students may not take it seriously. Maybe a good solution is free places for the best students and cheaper fees for others. That seems fair to me.

text: Both are important, but I think school is a little more important. At school, children learn subjects and also how to work in a team. At home, parents teach values and good manners. For example, my parents taught me to respect older people, and no teacher did this. So school and family must work together. Neither of them can do everything alone.

text: I don't think so, at least not completely. Computers can give information and check tests quickly, but they can't understand students' feelings. A good teacher motivates students and notices when somebody has a problem. For me, the best classes were the ones with a kind, interesting teacher. In my view, technology can help teachers, but it can't take their place.

tips.en: Hedging language sounds natural and avoids over-categorical claims.
